<h2>Prepare an sjSDM Artifact Payload for Stable Hashing</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Recursively removes materialization and migration-trace fields before an
artifact payload contributes to its stable scientific content hash.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>prepare_sjsdm_artifact_hash_payload(value = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="value">value</code></td>
<td>
<p>Artifact payload value or nested component.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Payload value with unstable trace fields removed.
</p>

</main>
